object: APERTURE 0.5 usability hardening after concrete ordinary-use failures

before.continuity: AXIAL source switches discarded local history; APERTURE focus state could not be resumed through DOCS URLs; AXIAL RETURN receipts were display-only.
before.temporal: RSVP inferred playback from timer existence, silently wrapped at the final unit, and an addressable DOCS host could rewrite browser history at RSVP cadence.
before.language: TEXT WORD units used whitespace tokenization, collapsing continuous scripts such as Chinese/Japanese/Thai into coarse units.
before.speech: SpeechSynthesis boundary callbacks had no generation token, so a late callback from cancelled speech could mutate a newer source.

operation: Made AXIAL cross-source BACK restore exact pre-switch state and made local RETURN receipts replayable.
Made APERTURE restore scale/address/index/WPM and made DOCS encode that reading state in its URL with COPY VIEW.
Separated RSVP playing state from timer scheduling; finite playback now stops at the final unit unless loop is explicit.
Throttled DOCS URL checkpoints during active high-speed RSVP and flush exact focus on pause/end.
Transferred Painting Path's Intl.Segmenter language-aware word/sentence/grapheme mechanism with source offsets and GRAPHEME scale.
Transferred Painting Path's speech cancellation-token law so stale TTS callbacks cannot move a newer source.

lineage.transfer_rule: Recover proven temporal/segmentation mechanisms; do not absorb Painting Path identity, geometry, route, challenge or action semantics.

after.snapshot: field-aperture-focus/v0.2 now also reports locale / playing / loop
after.temporal_default: FINITE; cyclic geometry remains independent from cyclic time
after.multilingual: Intl.Segmenter WORD / SENTENCE / GRAPHEME with fallback; load(...,{locale}) supported
after.durable_state: HOST_OWNED; DOCS uses addressable URL state, AXIAL local RETURN uses replayable host state

proof.static: LensState laws, route grammar, HUMAN PORT object aperture and public-surface contracts remain green.
proof.human: NOT_CLAIMED — comprehension advantage, preferred WPM, ORP/chunking and material projection value remain ordinary-use questions.

non_claims: High WPM does not imply comprehension.
Language-aware segmentation does not claim linguistic perfection.
GRAPHEME is an inspection/temporal unit, not a semantic word.
APERTURE remains an inspector; it does not acquire canonical truth, constraint-solving or actuation authority.
return: The instrument can now be left, resumed, replayed, read at speed without runaway URL churn, and used across the recovered multilingual corpus without whitespace-token collapse.
next: Stop architecture work. Reopen only from a concrete ordinary-use failure; likely remaining temporal candidates are ORP/chunking or presentation density, each requiring its own evidence.
